description: Mika's Mod Collection ported to Balatro3DS: 58 of 60 Jokers, the 3 default-enabled consumables (Ace of Pentacles, Page of Pentacles, Incense) and 6 of 7 decks. The decks need the fork's SMODS.Back registration and several Jokers use its blind-target and debt-limit APIs. Dagonet and Cicero are not ported (see README).
